nodes.name: PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Long design and progress document for the Zalo assistant bot, covering channel choice, architecture, polling vs webhook, storage, group-chat modes, security, roadmap, and later plans for the admin web dashboard, the Windows ZaloBot.exe packaging, and VPS control.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Vietnamese; the header notes that file names are from the original design and may differ from the current layout.

nodes.name: lenh-zalo.md
nodes.summary: User guide for bot commands on Zalo: the basic-user, leader and owner roles, a command table with minimum roles, default-mode invocation, assigning calendar events via the iforgotmywayhome web app, first-time ID lookup and the daily token budget.

nodes.name: vps-dieu-khien.md
nodes.summary: Explains how the Windows ZaloBot.exe app controls and hands over the bot to a VPS, including Gmail-based device-key login, standby mode, handover packages, and the one-time root setup (systemd unit, polkit or sudoers, nginx settings).
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Vietnamese; includes systemd, polkit JS, sudoers and bash snippets.
